injects.title: Peak Flow Alert at Sukkur
injects.description: River flows at Sukkur Barrage have reached 500,000 cusecs. Immediate activation of flood control centers in Sukkur, Shikarpur, and Khairpur is required.

injects.title: Tarbela Dam Status
injects.description: Tarbela Reservoir has reached maximum capacity due to glacial melt and confluence of western and monsoon disturbances. Emergency spillway operations initiated.
